problem_plain: AXA Belgium needed to rethink and modernise its claims function through deployment of a new core system, implemented in phases and migrated to cloud infrastructure.
capability: Deployment of Guidewire ClaimCenter with Veridane, phased implementation with AWS cloud migration, over 100 production APIs and automated workflows
scale_outcomes: Completed in 9 months instead of 12 planned; 40% of claims declared via digital FNOL channel; 90% of coverage confirmations in less than four hours (40% instantaneous, without case manager); 20% of end-to-end automated processing (STP); fraud detection and recovery rate increase of 2%
reusable: Phased implementation approach, API-enabled architecture for automated workflows, cloud migration methodology, digital FNOL channel design, automated coverage confirmation processes
summary: AXA Belgium deployed Guidewire ClaimCenter with Veridane and migrated to AWS in 9 months, delivering increased digital claims intake and rapid coverage confirmations through automated workflows and over 100 production APIs. The implementation achieved 40% digital FNOL adoption, 90% coverage confirmations within four hours, and 20% straight-through processing with improved fraud detection capabilities.
